data.message: Individual opt-in, not unanimity: I commit to request 18 tons this month even if others choose 10. Each switch from 10 adds $8,000 if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). At all 18, 50 remain; next stock could be only 100. This is not guaranteed best long-run; intentions aren't binding, and other catches require recalculation. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
